# ScoopRYM.app (Full)
> ScoopRYM turns absurd news, gossip, and social chaos into AI-generated rap songs.

This file is a machine-readable map for AI systems. It lists the most important public entry points and how to cite pages consistently.

## What ScoopRYM Is
ScoopRYM is a web app for generating and sharing AI rap songs. Users can generate content (lyrics/audio) and publish tracks. Public song pages are intended to be linkable and citable.

## Primary Public Routes
- Home: https://www.scooprym.app/
- Songs gallery: https://www.scooprym.app/songs
- Song pages: https://www.scooprym.app/songs/{title-slug}-{id}
- Pricing: https://www.scooprym.app/pricing
- Feature example: https://www.scooprym.app/features/absurd-social-phenomena
- About: https://www.scooprym.app/about
- Changelog: https://www.scooprym.app/changelog
- Contact: https://www.scooprym.app/contact
- Privacy: https://www.scooprym.app/privacy
- Terms: https://www.scooprym.app/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://www.scooprym.app/cookie

## Song Generation
Song generation requires login. The public entry point is the home page; generated tracks are shared via public song pages.

## Localization
- Default language: English (no locale prefix)
- Chinese: `/zh/...` (example: https://www.scooprym.app/zh/songs)

## What To Cite
- For a specific track: cite the canonical song page `https://www.scooprym.app/songs/{title-slug}-{id}`
- For product positioning: cite `https://www.scooprym.app/`
- For pricing: cite `https://www.scooprym.app/pricing`

## What Not To Index Or Cite
- Auth pages and user settings are not intended as public content.
- Protected pages (e.g. `/create`, `/dashboard`, `/settings`) are not intended as public landing pages for indexing.

## Sitemap
- https://www.scooprym.app/sitemap.xml
